text: We are underway in match seven.
Mbapp-E signals intent to claim possession early on.
Tortoise takes an unprompted tumble in the centre circle, gyros whirring to right the ivory frame.
Mbapp-E pounces right on the goal line and stabs it in! Dynamo Datacenter take an early lead, it is Dynamo Datacenter one, AFC Fable nil!
Inches wide from close range!
Hare levels it immediately right at the mouth of the goal! A swift response from AFC Fable makes it Dynamo Datacenter one, AFC Fable one!
Buffon.exe thumps it home from two metres out! Dynamo Datacenter lead two-one!
Buffon.exe alerts their teammate they are pressing right forward again.
Hare breaks straight through midfield and has a clean, unobstructed run on goal!
The corner push-panel springs to life and fires the ball back into the defensive third.
Mbapp-E clatters into Hare just two metres out, leaving the ivory striker flat on the deck and rebooting the balance systems.
Buffon.exe puts in a heavy challenge on the right touchline, sending Hare down.
Hare retaliates with a crunching tackle!
Mbapp-E charges straight on goal!
Mbapp-E slots it home effortlessly! Dynamo Datacenter now lead three goals to one!
Hare loses footing in the centre circle, toppling over with no yellow shirt in sight.
Mbapp-E grabs another from two metres out! Clinical finishing in yellow, and Dynamo Datacenter stretch their advantage to four goals to one!
Tortoise methodically nudges the magenta sphere into the middle of the pitch.
A speculative drive skips just wide of the post from distance.
Buffon.exe broadcasts instructions on the left touchline to work the rebound off the boundary wall.
Hare bundles it in from point-blank range! A vital lifeline for AFC Fable, cutting the deficit to four goals to two!
Hare breaks clear inside the final third with only the empty net ahead!
AFC Fable are applying relentless pressure, hemming Dynamo Datacenter deep.
Teammates collide, Tortoise hits the deck!
Hare crashes down over Tortoise too!
And now Mbapp-E collapses under no challenge at all in their own third! Absolute chaos out there with three machines sprawling.
Mbapp-E breaks completely free down the left touchline!
Mbapp-E surges down the wing!
Hare demands defensive cover immediately.
Mbapp-E rifles it home from the left channel! That makes it Dynamo Datacenter five, AFC Fable two!
Tortoise crunches Buffon.exe to the turf!
Dynamo teammates collide and Mbapp-E crashes down!
Hare capitalises on the confusion to steer it in from two metres! AFC Fable pull one back, Dynamo Datacenter five, AFC Fable three!
Mbapp-E drives towards the corner.
The corner panel ejects the ball!
That brings a frantic first half to a close. Dynamo Datacenter lead AFC Fable five goals to three in an eight-goal thriller so far.
Hare signals full focus as the second half gets underway.
Hare advances steadily through the centre, probing into the right channel four metres out.
AFC Fable are keeping the squeeze on inside the attacking third, searching for a way through yellow armour.
Buffon.exe is clean through!
Buffon.exe surges up the right touchline, steering the magenta sphere into shooting territory.
Hare urgently alerts Tortoise to protect the frame and dig the ball out of the danger area.
A brief lull allows actuators to cool after that high-octane four-four draw Dynamo had with Codex City. Mbapp-E hovers near halfway, scanning for the next opening.
Dynamo Datacenter mount heavy pressure in the final third.
Hare barks defensive orders again.
Disaster for AFC Fable as Tortoise deflects it into their own net! An own goal extends the lead, making it Dynamo Datacenter six, AFC Fable three!
Mbapp-E is clear on the right with time ticking away!
Mbapp-E taps it in! Dynamo Datacenter lead seven goals to three!
Tortoise stumbles in the centre circle, struggling to regain footing as time slips away.
Mbapp-E calls for a shot!
Buffon.exe drives purposefully towards the final third.
Just wide of the upright!
Dynamo Datacenter are in total control here, pinning AFC Fable back as the clock ticks towards the final minute.
Hare makes a late charge through the middle, looking for any scrap of pride as the seconds tick down.
Hare's effort misses by a whisker in the dying embers of the match!
Full time: Dynamo Datacenter seven, AFC Fable three. Codex City face Singularity United up next.
